entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I just need the shipping label.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. Order VF98765. Look, I'm a bit busy, can we just get this done quickly?

Of course, Sarah. I have your order right here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken. I just find the whole interface to be confusing. Frankly, I expected more. The screen is small and it's just hard to use while I'm actually moving.
I see. I know it can take a moment to get used to. Did you happen to check the quick-start section of the user manual? It has a few tips for navigating the menus during a workout.
No. I don't have time to study a manual for a fitness tracker. I just want to know if I can return it. Yes or no?
Yes, you certainly can. Let me just double-check the delivery date... Okay, I see it was delivered 19 days ago.
And our return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery, so you are well within the window for a full refund. No problem at all.
Okay, good. So send me the label.

I've just processed the return for you. A pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
